result.note: Tests the June 2026 India–Nepal launch of person-to-person UPI remittances, a payment-systems fact with a neighbourhood-policy angle.

questions.prompt: In June 2026, India launched instant cross-border UPI remittances for person-to-person transfers with which neighbouring country?
questions.explain: India and Nepal launched instant cross-border UPI remittances on 12 June 2026, extending the link beyond merchant QR payments to full person-to-person transfers. TBB described it as a durable strategic play in a country where China has expanded its footprint.
questions.source: India and Nepal launched instant cross-border UPI remittances, going beyond merchant QR payments to full person-to-person transfers
